lastCompletedStory.title: Classify local prune by end-state and force-delete with `git branch -D`

nextStoryContext: US-002 added checkAndPruneLocalBranch helper (rev-parse pre-check -> force delete via -D -> rev-parse post-check -> end-state classification). Mirrors checkAndPruneRemoteBranch exactly. happySpawn fake now models rev-parse --verify --quiet refs/heads/<branch> calls (pre and post, with a lsRemoteCallCount-style counter). Default revParseLocalPreStatus=128 means branch already absent (no -D called). Tests that need the delete path must pass revParseLocalPreStatus:0. The next story (US-003) addresses narration coalescing in the supervisor.

officialDocsValidated.summary: git rev-parse --verify --quiet exits non-zero + empty stdout when ref is absent; SHA on stdout on success. Implementation matches: absent = (status !== 0) || (stdout.trim() === '').
